import SystemE
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false

namespace Elements.Book3

set_option systemE.solverTime 30 in
theorem helper_3_11_hd_ex (g h : Point) (ADE : Circle)
    (h_gc : g.isCentre ADE) (h_out : h.outsideCircle ADE) :
    ∃ d : Point, d.onCircle ADE ∧ between g d h := by
  euclid_apply (line_from_points g h) as L
  euclid_apply (intersection_circle_line_between_points ADE L g h) as d
  euclid_finish

end Elements.Book3

import SystemE
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false

namespace Elements.Book3

set_option systemE.solverTime 30 in
theorem helper_3_11_step2 (a f g : Point) (ABC ADE : Circle) (AF AG : Line)
    (h_aABC : a.onCircle ABC) (h_fc : f.isCentre ABC)
    (h_aADE : a.onCircle ADE) (h_gc : g.isCentre ADE)
    (h_aAF : a.onLine AF) (h_fAF : f.onLine AF)
    (h_aAG : a.onLine AG) (h_gAG : g.onLine AG) :
    distinctPointsOnLine a f AF ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a g AG := by
  euclid_finish

end Elements.Book3
